title: Agrodome Farm Show Review
meta_desc: Discover the Agrodome Farm Show in Rotorua, a fun and educational experience for families with kids aged 2+, featuring sheep, cattle and interactive shows
intro: The Agrodome Farm Show is a Rotorua institution, entertaining families for over 50 years. We took our kids to find out what all the fuss is about. With a 1.5 hour showtime and a price tag of $44 per adult and $25 per child, is it worth the cost? We dive into the details, including age suitability, value for money, and insider tips.

sections.heading: What to Expect
sections.body:
The Agrodome Farm Show is a fully undercover, 1-hour show that's perfect for rainy days. The show features a working sheep and cattle farm, where kids can feed lambs, watch sheep being shorn, and see sheepdogs work. Our kids loved the interactive elements, and the show was engaging and entertaining for the entire family.

With a minimum age of 2+, this show is suitable for young children, and the staff are friendly and accommodating. The show's pace is well-suited for kids, with a mix of action, education, and comedy.

sections.heading: Value for Money
sections.body: With prices starting at $25 per child and $44 per adult, the Agrodome Farm Show may seem like a costly outing. However, considering the 1.5 hour showtime and the unique experience on offer, we feel it's worth the cost. The show is both entertaining and educational, making it a great value for families.

sections.heading: Insider Tips and Booking
sections.body:
To make the most of your visit, book your tickets in advance to avoid sold-out shows. Consider visiting during the week or outside of peak season to avoid crowds. The Agrodome also offers a range of packages and deals, including a farm tour and a visit to the nearby Rainbow Springs Nature Park.

Be sure to arrive at least 30 minutes before the show to allow time for parking and getting settled. The Agrodome has a cafe and shop on site, offering a range of snacks and souvenirs.

sections.heading: Best Time to Visit
sections.body: The Agrodome Farm Show is a great activity for rainy days, as it's fully undercover. However, if you're looking for a more authentic farm experience, consider visiting during the spring or summer months when the farm is in full production. The show runs daily, with multiple showtimes to choose from.

sections.heading: Downsides for Families
sections.body:
While the Agrodome Farm Show is a great activity for families, there are a few downsides to consider. The show can be quite crowded, especially during peak season, and the seating is not always comfortable. Additionally, some of the show's content may not be suitable for very young or sensitive children.

However, overall we found the Agrodome Farm Show to be a fun and engaging experience for our family, and we would highly recommend it to other families with kids aged 2+.
